choices: Sea told me to come to the student council room
Go to the library to see Yuna
Stop by to say hello to Ms. Eunsu

day1_after_sea_1.text: *A small room. Two desks, a locker, a plant by the window. Neatly organized.*

day1_after_sea_2.text: You came. This is the student council room.

day1_after_sea_3.text: *She hands me a canned drink. The tab has already been lifted a little, so it’ll open easily.*

day1_after_sea_4.text: So, how are you settling in?

day1_after_sea_5.text: Better than I expected. You've been looking after me a lot, Sea.

day1_after_sea_7.text: *Sea lets out a small breath and smiles.*

day1_after_sea_8.text: The first day is always like that. You keep checking where to sit and who to say hi to.

day1_after_sea_9.text: *Sea looks out the window. The sunset light streams in.*

day1_after_sea_10.text: ...I'm glad you came. Around this time, the fluorescent lights sound louder.

day1_after_sea_11.text: What about the other student council members?

day1_after_sea_12.text: There are some, but... I'm the only one who comes here after school.

day1_after_sea_15.text: I'll be waiting. If you don't come, I might come find you first.

day1_after_sea_16.text: *Sea looks into my eyes to make sure. She’s smiling, but she doesn’t blink until she hears my answer.*

day1_after_yuna_1.text: *Yuna is organizing photos at a window seat.*

day1_after_yuna_3.text: *Yuna flips through her camera and shows me photos. School scenery, cherry blossoms, cats.*

day1_after_yuna_4.text: This cat is Cheese. I named him.

day1_after_yuna_5.text: *Yuna added the cat's name every time she flipped through the photos. The camera strap shook slightly on my wrist.*

day1_after_yuna_6.text: ...Will you come to the library again tomorrow?

day1_after_yuna_9.text: *There was weight behind that “definitely.” Yuna wrapped the camera strap twice around her finger, then unwound it.*

day1_after_yuna_10.text: *As I leave the library, Yuna follows me out.*

day1_after_yuna_12.text: *Yuna holds out a Polaroid photo. The view from the library window earlier.*

day1_after_yuna_13.text: This is... the seat you sat in, sunbae. The light is nice there. Take it.

day1_after_yuna_14.text: *I took the photo. A moment of sunlight falling on a book. I couldn't help but smile.*

day1_after_riin_1.text: *I had herbal tea with Ms. Riin. A faint steam rose from the rim of the paper cup.*

day1_after_riin_2.text: Sleep can be shallow on your first day after transferring. Your body notices an unfamiliar place first.

day1_after_riin_5.text: *Ms. Riin pauses for a moment, then opens the cabinet.*

day1_after_riin_7.text: *She hands me a small bag. A few herbal tea bags.*

day1_after_riin_8.text: If you can't sleep well, brew a cup before bed. It's chamomile.

day1_after_riin_10.text: *Ms. Riin plays a calm piano piece from the speaker. The volume is so low that I feel the rhythm before the melody.*

day1_after_riin_11.text: Come by around this time again. I'll make tea.

day1_after_riin_12.text: *Ms. Riin smiles and holds the door open. Walking down the hall, I fiddle with the tea bag packet. It's still warm.*

day1_after_eunsu_1.text: {name}? You came to see me after school? Is something wrong?

day1_after_eunsu_2.text: *As she makes coffee, she asks me a few things. My previous school, my commute, what I ate this morning.*

day1_after_eunsu_3.text: ...Your previous school's paperwork came in late. Did something happen?

day1_after_eunsu_4.text: Unusual? I only transferred because my parents moved.

day1_after_eunsu_6.text: *The teacher sets down her coffee cup and closes the folder.*

day1_after_eunsu_7.text: Oh right, {name}, did you get all your textbooks?

day1_after_eunsu_8.text: Yes, Sea took care of everything.

day1_after_eunsu_9.text: Sea's been looking after you. If anything is difficult, come to me. I'm your homeroom teacher.

day1_after_eunsu_10.text: *Ms. Eunsu smiles and pats my back. For a moment, only the warmth of her palm remains where the uniform cloth was pressed down.*

day1_after_home_1.text: *Walking out the school gate, I glance back.*

day1_after_home_3.text: *...Someone is looking down at me from the third-floor window.*

day1_after_home_4.text: *The backlight hides the face. Just a silhouette. Near the window seat in the very back row.*

day1_after_home_6.text: *I turn around and walk. Time to head home.*
